integrity: Explicit orbit-clique proof and repeatable standalone finite checker; integer wedge classification comes from proof, not finite mod-two tests.
scientific_limitations: Exact homotopy type for the coordinate-exchange geometric fixed locus of the elementary abelian 2-group Latin-square clique complex, for group orders at least eight; not general abelian groups, other involutions or integral ambient group representations. Only self-review has been done.
title: Transpose-fixed Latin-square clique complexes are circle bouquets
